headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins fell to the Cleveland Guardians in a 5-2 loss, with Ryan Jeffers leading the Twins' offense. Parker Messick pitched 5.2 strong innings for the Twins, striking out six and allowing just one earned run. The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 2-1, with Max Muncy delivering a crucial home run. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 12-2 victory. The San Diego Padres secured an 8-3 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Manny Machado leading the charge at the plate. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, snapping their winning streak.

Several players have been impacted by injuries. The Toronto Blue Jays placed LF Jonatan Clase on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis. The Baltimore Orioles placed C Samuel Basallo on the 10-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The Athletics placed RHP J.T. Ginn on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister. The Kansas City Royals transferred RHP Stephen Kolek from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right flexor strain. The Kansas City Royals placed SS Bobby Witt Jr. on the 10-day injured list due to low back tightness. The Arizona Diamondbacks placed RHP Drey Jameson on the 15-day injured list due to right hip inflammation. The Detroit Tigers placed RHP Jack Flaherty on the 15-day injured list due to right flexor inflammation. The Texas Rangers placed RHP Jose Corniell on the 15-day injured list.

Several teams have made roster moves. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for RHP Aiden Moffett. The Kansas City Royals traded RF Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in 5-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 5-2 decision to the Cleveland Guardians, with Ryan Jeffers leading the Twins' offense with a home run and an RBI. Parker Messick pitched 5.2 strong innings for the Twins, striking out six and allowing just one earned run.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 2-1, with Max Muncy delivering a crucial home run (19) on a fly ball to center field, scoring Andy Pages.

top_news.title: **Rays Cruise Past Blue Jays 12-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 12-2 victory. Nick Fortes led the offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Braves 8-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured an 8-3 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Manny Machado leading the charge at the plate. Machado hit two home runs and drove in two runs in the game.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Upset in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, snapping their winning streak. Impact players for the Pirates included Jake Mangum, Nick Gonzales, Jacob Gonzalez, and Ben Rice, while Mitch Keller shone on the mound.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles in their latest matchup. Impact hitters from both teams included Pete Alonso, Christian Encarnacion-Strand, Jackson Holliday, Ceddanne Rafaela, and Willson Contreras.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Clase Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays left fielder Jonatan Clase has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis, with the move retroactive to July 21, 2026.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
